title: Any Two Positive Numbers Summing to S
description:
Given an integer S (2 <= S <= 10000), output ANY two positive integers x and y (1 <= x, y <= S-1) on a single line such that x + y = S.

Because many different answers are correct (e.g. for S = 10 you may output '1 9', '2 8', ... or '9 1'), this problem is judged by a Special Judge rather than by exact string comparison.
output: Two positive integers x and y separated by a space, with x + y = S and 1 <= x, y <= S-1.
note: Judged by spj.cpp: it checks x and y are positive, x < S, y < S, and x + y == S. Order does not matter.
